apps.name: Fruitlight Doku
apps.subtitle: Akari Light Up Logic Puzzles
apps.description:
Light the orchard with logic.

Fruitlight Doku is a fruit-lantern puzzle game inspired by Akari (Light Up). Place lanterns to illuminate every empty square. Lanterns must not shine on each other, and each numbered wall tells you exactly how many lanterns belong beside it.

A LITTLE LIGHT, A CLEAR IDEA
• Explore an illustrated orchard with a different cover for every chapter.
• Learn through early puzzles, then take on increasingly challenging boards.
• Play a daily challenge alongside the main journey.
• Mark squares, undo moves and use explanations or reveal a lantern when you need a hand.
• Earn light seeds through play and check every reward and expense in your history.
• Enjoy layouts for iPhone and iPad, including landscape on iPad.
• Choose English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, Traditional Chinese, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese or Korean.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
The first 60 campaign levels are free. Later levels can be unlocked individually with light seeds earned in the game. Optional Fruitlight Doku Pro is a one-time in-app purchase that unlocks all campaign levels, grants 120 light seeds on first activation and increases first-clear rewards. Pro is not a subscription. Hints and reveals still use light seeds.

TIMED CHALLENGE
Solve a series of Light Up boards before time runs out. Start twice daily for free, or without a daily limit with Pro. A new run uses an attempt; resuming the same run does not use another.

Game Center is optional. Core puzzles work offline. With iCloud enabled, supported progress and your Light Seed wallet can sync between devices using the same iCloud account. Optional repeatable consumable packs add 120 or 420 Light Seeds. Gameplay spending and rewards apply locally immediately; sync runs outside gameplay. Internet is required for wallet setup and purchase delivery. Restore Purchases restores Pro; finished consumables are recovered through the existing iCloud wallet, not granted again. Allow sync to finish before changing devices or deleting the app.

Privacy policy: https://cgq-source.github.io/fruitlight-doku-support/privacy.html
Terms: https://cgq-source.github.io/fruitlight-doku-support/terms.html

ORCHARD EXPEDITION
Follow a free five-stop route through the Mirror Grove. Fixed mirrors bend light, and repair puzzles ask you to move lanterns within a limited number of moves. Continue offline or replay completed stops. Expedition progress stays on this device.

topResults.name: Puzzlerama - Fun Puzzle Games
topResults.description:
Puzzlerama is a collection of the best puzzles in the store: Lines, Tangram, Pipes, Blocks, Dots, Shikaku, Unroll, Unblock, Sokoban and Bridges all in one game. It is the definitive stop for puzzle lovers, with more than 4,000 levels to relax, unwind and sharpen your logic skills. Better than any brain training, these Zen puzzles have no time limits but almost infinite fun! Puzzlerama merged all the king puzzles in a collection that will keep your mind active and entertained for hundreds of hours.  And more puzzle games will be added in the future.

Puzzlerama collection currently includes:

- Lines – Number Link -
Lines is a classic free Japanese game also known as Number Link or Arukone. You have to connect the pair of dots of the same color so the lines do not cross or overlap.  The entire board must be filled. 

- Color Fill – Tangram -
Color Fill is based on Tangram, the classic Chinese dissection puzzle. The goal is fill the entire board by dragging the geometric shapes. Color Fill is a great reasoning puzzle that trains your spatial intelligence and your geometric skills. 

- Pipes – Plumber -
Pipes, also known as Plumber, is a rotation puzzle where you have to connect all the pipes to let the water flow through the pipeline. Tap the pipes to rotate them and connect the pipes of the same color. Pipes starts easy, but different pipelines and other twists makes it challenging in later difficulties. Don´t worry, there is no risk of flooding; the liquid is safely contained inside the pipeline!

- Block Puzzle -
Block Puzzle is as simple yet extremely addicting puzzle game about blocks. Similar to Color Fill, the goal is to complete the entire board by dragging the block pieces. Blocks can´t be rotated, and the board changes horizontally and vertically every level, with different number of rows and columns each time. An hexa mode will be added in the future.

- Shikaku -
Shikaku, also known as rectangles, is another classic Japanese game from the same inventor of Sudoku. Shikaku is played on a square or rectangular grid with some numbered cells. The objective is to divide the grid into different areas, each of them containing 1 numbered cell and the exact number of squares indicated in that numbered cell. Later Shikaku introduces new concepts and cells that keep it interesting and challenging.

- Unroll -
Unroll is a unique thought-provoking brain teaser inspired by slide puzzles. Move the tiles to form a path that connects the green and red tiles and watch the ball roll. Unroll features 250 levels in 5 difficulties or packs. Unlock the fun now! 

- Unblock -
Unblock is a deceivingly simple yet challenging sliding block puzzle game. The objective is to move the blue block to the exit, by sliding the horizontal blocks side to side or the vertical blocks up and down.  Wooden pieces, cars or even a mouse, unblock has come in different variations but none of them equals Puzzlerama´s. Don´t worry if all the pieces seems interlocked, just move them out of the way!

- Bridges -
Bridges, also known as Hashi, consists on a series of islands that need to be connected following a couple simple rules.  You can only connect two horizontally or vertically adjacent islands, you can connect a pair of island with only 1 or 2 bridges and each island should be connected the indicated number of times. Bridges can´t cross each other and all islands have to be connected in a single configuration. In the future we will include an extreme version with the possibility of diagonal moves.

- Sokoban -
Sokoban is the classic game about moving boxes. Push the boxes until all the boxes are over the red dots.  Same as the original version, this Sokoban is quite challenging.
